newsitem.title: USA: Ciba says head of U.S. drug unit resigns.
newsitem.headline: Ciba says head of U.S. drug unit resigns.

text.p: Ciba-Geigy AG said on Wednesday that the James Callahan had resigned from his post as president of the company's U.S. pharmaceuticals unit.
Callahan decided to take early retirement "for personal and professional reasons," Ciba-Geigy said.

Callahan had been designated chief executive of Novartis Pharmaceuticals, the U.S. pharmaceuticals division to be formed from the merger of Ciba and Sandoz AG, which is pending U.S. regulatory approval.

E.J. Fullagar, CEO of Sandoz Corp, will act as the designated CEO of Novartis Pharmaceuticals until a new CEO is appointed, Ciba said. He will be responsible for guiding the integration of the Ciba-Geigy and Sandoz pharmaceuticals businesses in the U.S, the company said.
Recruiting for a new CEO has begun, it said.
